title: Normalized descended comparison for ordinary and completed tensor
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and a scheme W whose residue fields invert ell. Use the actual ordinary tensor, completion unit and representative isomorphism of lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation and the natural chain map of lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-chain. There exists a natural transformation tau from ordinary derived tensor to the specified completed tensor whose representative equation is exactly the localization of that chain map. Whenever the canonical completion unit on the ordinary tensor of M,N is invertible, tau on M,N is invertible. No constructibility hypothesis or completeness conclusion is part of this statement.

proof.text: Take beta from the recorded normalized tensor completion model. Define tau as beta after the canonical completion unit, whiskered by ordinary tensor. Left-compose the model equation with the representative isomorphism. Cancel its composite with its inverse and use the component equation of the canonical chain map to obtain the stated representative normalization.

theorem tensorCompletionComparison
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)] :
    ∃ τ : ordinaryTensor l E W ⟶ integralCompletedTensor l E W,
      (∀ P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory,
        (tensorRepresentativeIso l E W).hom.app (P, Q) ≫
          τ.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
          (integralCompletedTensorComparison l E W).hom.app (P, Q) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((tensorCompletionChain l E W).app (P.obj, Q.obj))) ∧
      ∀ M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W),
        IsIso ((tensorCompletionUnit l E W).app ((ordinaryTensor l E W).obj (M, N))) →
          IsIso (τ.app (M, N))
